rationale: Require bounded recommendation, stateful independent challenge, and owner-resolution artifacts plus a deterministic chain gate so invalid or unproven options cannot be recommended through secondary optimization and high-risk decisions cannot self-approve or reuse reviewer context.
migration: After adopting this release, route every new material owner decision through recommendation review start, the assignment-bound validate-chain gate, and a valid owner resolution before dependent work continues. Existing completed decisions remain historical and require no backfill.
